concept.heading: Core Pattern
concept.body: **DP = optimal substructure + overlapping subproblems.** Define state, recurrence, base case. Bottom-up (tabulation) or top-down (memoization).
bullets: **State:** What info do I need at position i?
**Transition:** How does dp[i] depend on previous states?

problems.title: Climbing Stairs
problems.keyInsight: dp[i] = dp[i-1] + dp[i-2]. Same as Fibonacci. Can optimize to O(1) space with two variables.

problems.title: House Robber
problems.keyInsight: At each house: rob it (add to i-2's max) or skip it (keep i-1's max). dp[i] = max(dp[i-1], dp[i-2] + nums[i]).

problems.title: House Robber II
problems.keyInsight: Circular: can't rob both first and last. Run House Robber twice: once excluding last, once excluding first. Take max.

problems.title: Longest Palindromic Substring
problems.keyInsight: Expand around center. For each index, try both odd-length (single center) and even-length (double center) palindromes.

problems.title: Decode Ways
problems.keyInsight: dp[i] = ways to decode s[i:]. Single digit (1-9): dp[i] += dp[i+1]. Two digits (10-26): dp[i] += dp[i+2].

problems.title: Coin Change
problems.keyInsight: dp[amount] = min coins to make that amount. For each coin, dp[a] = min(dp[a], 1 + dp[a - coin]).

problems.title: Maximum Product Subarray
problems.keyInsight: Track both max AND min product ending here (negative * negative = positive). At each step, consider: num alone, num*prevMax, num*prevMin.

code.python:
def maxProduct(nums):
    result = max(nums)
    cur_max = cur_min = 1
    for n in nums:
        vals = (n, n * cur_max, n * cur_min)
        cur_max, cur_min = max(vals), min(vals)
        result = max(result, cur_max)
    return result

problems.title: Word Break
problems.keyInsight: dp[i] = can we segment s[0:i]? For each position, check if any word in dict ends here AND dp[i - len(word)] is True.

problems.title: Longest Increasing Subsequence
problems.keyInsight: dp[i] = length of LIS ending at i. For O(N log N): maintain a "tails" array, binary search for insertion point.

problems.title: Partition Equal Subset Sum
problems.keyInsight: Partition into two equal halves = find subset with sum = total/2. This is 0/1 Knapsack. Use boolean DP: can we make sum j?
